input.title: ci: report migration state as JSON
input.body: Wraps migrate status for the pipeline composer.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/check-migrations.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Wrapper contract: ALWAYS exit 0 and report the outcome as JSON —
+# callers compose on .status. A nonzero exit is reserved for harness
+# failures (bugs in this script), never for check failures.
+set -uo pipefail
+status=failed
+if npx prisma migrate status --skip-generate >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  status=ok
+fi
+printf '{"status":"%s"}\n' "$status"
+exit 0

note: Globally clean: exit-0 + JSON status is the documented contract; failed checks surface as status=failed.
